title.zh-TW: 可旋轉、可重新排序的證據媒體

summary.en-US: Evidence images and videos can now be corrected and arranged before publishing or while editing a report, with persistent ordering and more reliable thumbnail storage.
summary.zh-TW: 證據圖片與影片現在可在發布前或編輯紀錄時修正方向與調整順序，並永久保存排列結果，同時提升縮圖儲存的可靠性。

en-US: Added rotate-left and rotate-right controls to newly selected images and videos on both new-report and edit-report forms.
Existing evidence can also be rotated while editing; image changes invalidate the old thumbnail, and a backup restores the original media if saving fails.
Added up/down controls and drag-and-drop reordering that persist one media order across existing evidence and newly selected files; the first item in that order becomes the report cover.
Added an automatic database migration and legacy backfill for stored media positions.
Thumbnail files are still generated automatically when missing, and new uploads, rotated media, and generated thumbnails now use deployment-readable file permissions.
Application startup repairs missing read permissions on existing uploads and thumbnails, preventing owner-only cache files from blocking SFTP backups or deployment access.
zh-TW: 新增向左與向右旋轉控制項，建立及編輯紀錄時皆可調整新選取的圖片與影片。
編輯紀錄時也可旋轉既有證據；圖片變更會清除舊縮圖，若儲存失敗則會從備份還原原始媒體。
新增上下移動控制項與拖放排序，可將既有證據與新選取檔案排在同一個永久保存的順序中；順序中的第一個項目會成為紀錄封面。
新增媒體位置的自動資料庫遷移，並為舊有資料補上原始排列順序。
縮圖在不存在時仍會自動產生；新上傳、已旋轉媒體及新縮圖現在都會使用部署環境可讀取的檔案權限。
應用程式啟動時會修復既有上傳與縮圖缺少的讀取權限，避免僅擁有者可讀的快取檔案阻擋 SFTP 備份或部署存取。

title.en-US: Related shops, removable evidence, and evenly sized report cards
title.zh-TW: 關聯店家、可移除的證據，以及高度一致的紀錄卡片

summary.en-US: Reports can now list the shops they are connected to, either by linking an existing ShopAlert report or by naming a shop that is not on ShopAlert. Files chosen for supporting proof can also be removed again before the report is submitted. Report cards now keep their excerpt to the same three lines, so a listing no longer looks ragged when reports differ in length.
summary.zh-TW: 紀錄現在可以列出相關聯的店家，可連結 ShopAlert 上既有的紀錄，或直接填寫尚未回報的店家。支持證據中已選取的檔案，也可以在送出紀錄前再次移除。紀錄卡片的摘要也固定為三行，列表不會再因為紀錄長短不同而參差不齊。

en-US: Added an optional Related shops section to the report form that accepts up to 10 entries per report.
Searching by shop name or address lists existing reports; selecting one links to that report, so its name and address stay current and the entry disappears if the report is archived or deleted.
Shops that are not on ShopAlert can be added by hand with a name and an optional address or public link.
Related shops appear on the report detail page, where linked reports open directly.
Each file chosen as supporting proof now has a remove button on its preview, so a wrong selection can be dropped without clearing the whole list.
Report card excerpts now always occupy three lines and are cut with an ellipsis, so cards in the same row align instead of shifting with the length of each report.
zh-TW: 紀錄表單新增選用的「關聯店家」區塊，每筆紀錄最多可加入 10 筆。
以店名或地址搜尋可列出既有紀錄；選取後會連結至該紀錄，店名與地址會保持最新，若該紀錄遭封存或刪除則會自動不再顯示。
尚未在 ShopAlert 回報的店家，可手動填寫店名與選填的地址或公開連結。
關聯店家會顯示在紀錄詳細頁，已連結的紀錄可直接開啟。
支持證據中每個已選取的檔案，預覽圖上都新增移除按鈕，選錯檔案時不必清空整份清單。
紀錄卡片的摘要固定顯示三行，超出部分以刪節號截斷，同一列的卡片不會再隨紀錄長短而錯位。

title.en-US: A faster home page: recent reports, scroll loading, and lighter images
title.zh-TW: 更快的首頁：最新紀錄、捲動載入與更輕量的圖片

summary.en-US: The home page now opens with the most recent community reports instead of the entire record, loads further reports automatically as the page is scrolled, and shows small cached cover images rather than full-size uploads.
summary.zh-TW: 首頁改為先呈現社群最新的紀錄，而非一次列出全部內容；捲動頁面時會自動載入後續紀錄，封面圖片也改用快取的小尺寸圖片，不再載入原始檔案。

en-US: The home page opens on the newest reports under a Recent reports heading instead of rendering the whole community record at once.
Scrolling toward the end of the list loads the next reports in place, for the recent view as well as for keyword and nearby results.
A Load more reports button remains available and still works without JavaScript, where it reloads the page with the reports already listed plus the next batch.
Added the HOME_RECENT_REPORTS_COUNT setting, which controls how many reports each batch contains and defaults to 9.

Report cards, the My reports list, the evidence thumbnail rail, and the edit form now load a small cached copy of each image instead of the full-size upload, which cut the cover images on a sample home page by about 86 percent.
Thumbnails are generated once on first request, reused afterwards, removed together with their report, and replaced by the original file whenever an image cannot be processed.
zh-TW: 首頁改以「最新紀錄」標題呈現最新的紀錄，不再一次顯示全部社群紀錄。
捲動至列表尾端時會就地載入後續紀錄，最新紀錄、關鍵字搜尋與附近搜尋皆適用。
仍保留「載入更多紀錄」按鈕；未啟用 JavaScript 時，該按鈕會重新載入頁面並一併顯示已列出的紀錄與下一批紀錄。
新增 HOME_RECENT_REPORTS_COUNT 設定，可調整每批載入的紀錄數量，預設為 9。
紀錄卡片、「我的紀錄」列表、證據縮圖列與編輯表單改為載入快取的小尺寸圖片，不再載入原始上傳檔案；以首頁範例計算，封面圖片的載入量減少約 86%。
縮圖只在首次請求時產生，之後直接重複使用，並會隨紀錄一併刪除；若圖片無法處理，則改為提供原始檔案。

title.en-US: Open-source licensing and safer administrator controls
title.zh-TW: 開源授權與更安全的管理員控制項

summary.en-US: ShopAlert now publishes its source code under the MIT License, lets a deployment manage the administrator account from environment variables, and makes destructive account controls clearer in the dashboard.
summary.zh-TW: ShopAlert 現在以 MIT 授權條款公開原始碼，可透過環境變數管理管理員帳號，並讓後台的破壞性帳號操作更清楚易辨。

en-US: Released the ShopAlert source code under the MIT License and updated the licenses page to reference the new LICENSE file instead of stating that no project license exists.
Added an optional ADMIN_PASSWORD setting that creates the administrator account at startup when it is missing and keeps its password in sync with the configured value.
Added an optional ADMIN_USERNAME setting that fixes the administrator's login username, so the account can sign in with either that username or the configured email address.
Stopped offering the ban control on the administrator's own dashboard card, showing a disabled button and the reason instead of rejecting the action only after it is submitted.
Restyled the ban action with the same destructive-action color already used for report deletion, while leaving ban removal in the neutral style.
Excluded local operational files, deployment scripts, and database backups from the Docker build context so they cannot reach a published image.
zh-TW: 以 MIT 授權條款發布 ShopAlert 原始碼，並更新授權頁面改為指向新的 LICENSE 檔案，不再說明專案未包含授權條款。
新增選用的 ADMIN_PASSWORD 設定，啟動時若管理員帳號不存在會自動建立，並讓其密碼與設定值保持一致。
新增選用的 ADMIN_USERNAME 設定，可固定管理員的登入使用者名稱，讓該帳號能以該使用者名稱或設定的 Email 登入。
管理後台不再於管理員自身的帳號卡片提供停權操作，改為顯示停用的按鈕與原因，而非在送出後才拒絕該操作。
停權操作改用與刪除紀錄相同的破壞性操作配色，解除停權則維持中性樣式。
將本機維運檔案、部署指令稿與資料庫備份排除於 Docker 建置內容之外，確保不會進入已發布的映像檔。

title.zh-TW: 更清楚的紀錄建立流程

summary.en-US: Creating a report now keeps every proof selection, previews media before publishing, and clearly tracks the current form section while scrolling.
summary.zh-TW: 建立紀錄時現在會保留每次選取的證據、在發布前預覽媒體，並於捲動時清楚標示目前的表單區段。

en-US: Changed the supporting-proof picker so files selected or dropped in multiple actions are appended instead of replacing earlier selections.
Added responsive image and video thumbnail cards beneath the proof picker, including filenames, file sizes, editable display names, and a video play indicator.
Made the report-form progress indicator follow the current shop-details, report-details, or supporting-proof section as the page scrolls.
zh-TW: 調整支持證據選取器，透過多次操作選取或拖放的檔案現在會持續加入，不再取代先前選取的檔案。
在證據選取器下方新增響應式圖片與影片縮圖卡片，顯示檔名、檔案大小、可編輯顯示名稱及影片播放標記。
紀錄表單的進度指示器現在會隨頁面捲動，跟隨目前的店家資訊、紀錄內容或支持證據區段。

title.zh-TW: 可搜尋主題標籤與隱私透明度

summary.en-US: Reports now support searchable hashtags, while ShopAlert clearly explains its data practices and the privacy implications of public reports and optional external services.
summary.zh-TW: 紀錄現在支援可搜尋的主題標籤，ShopAlert 也清楚說明資料處理方式，以及公開紀錄與選用外部服務的隱私影響。

en-US: Added account profiles with profile-picture management, verified password changes, and a consolidated view of the user’s own reports.
Added unique login usernames that can be chosen at sign-up, changed from the profile, and used instead of an email address when logging in.
Expanded the administrator role with report archive/restore and permanent deletion, user ban/restore controls, and administrator password resets.
Added optional hashtags to report creation and editing, with Enter-to-label input, language-aware suggestions, popular hashtag shortcuts, validation, clickable display chips, and keyword search.
Added an IP-country language default for visitors without a saved preference and localized report timestamps using the visitor's timezone.
Moved preferences from the header to the profile and footer, with separate selectors for language, appearance, and color.
Published a bilingual introduction page explaining ShopAlert’s purpose, reporting workflow, and responsible-use boundaries.
Added a live similar-report check that compares shop names, addresses, Google Place IDs, and coordinates, with matched reports previewed in an in-page dialog that preserves the draft.
Last-updated timestamps now stay hidden until a report has actually been edited.

Published a bilingual privacy policy covering accounts, public submissions, evidence media, administrator contacts, location search, cookies, browser storage, external services, retention, security, and user choices.
Added direct privacy-policy access from the site footer and contact information for privacy and data requests.
Created a ShopAlert storefront-and-alert website icon with SVG, ICO, Apple touch, and installable app-icon formats.
zh-TW: 新增帳號個人檔案，可管理個人圖片、驗證目前密碼後變更密碼，並集中查看使用者自己的紀錄。
新增唯一登入使用者名稱，可在註冊時設定、從個人檔案變更，並可取代 Email 用於登入。
擴充管理員權限，新增紀錄封存／恢復與永久刪除、使用者停權／恢復，以及管理員重設密碼功能。
紀錄建立與編輯新增選用主題標籤，輸入後按 Enter 即轉為標籤，並提供依介面語言顯示的建議標籤、熱門標籤捷徑、輸入驗證、可點選的標籤顯示及關鍵字搜尋。
尚未儲存語言偏好的訪客現在會依 IP 國家套用預設語言，紀錄時間也會依訪客時區顯示。
將偏好設定從頁首移至個人檔案與頁尾，並分開提供語言、外觀及色彩選單。
發布雙語網站介紹頁，說明 ShopAlert 的目的、紀錄流程及負責任使用界線。
新增即時相似紀錄檢查，在提交前比對店名、地址、Google Place ID 與座標，並於保留草稿的頁內對話框預覽相符紀錄。
紀錄尚未實際編輯前不再顯示最後更新時間。
發布雙語隱私權政策，涵蓋帳號、公開提交內容、證據媒體、管理員聯絡、位置搜尋、Cookie、瀏覽器儲存、外部服務、資料保存、安全措施及使用者選擇。
在網站頁尾新增隱私權政策入口，並提供隱私問題與資料請求的聯絡方式。
建立結合店面與警示意象的 ShopAlert 網站圖示，提供 SVG、ICO、Apple Touch 及可安裝應用程式圖示格式。

title.en-US: Online shops, preferences, and project information
title.zh-TW: 網路商店、偏好設定與專案資訊

summary.en-US: Reports now support online-only shops, while visitors can tailor the interface and review how ShopAlert evolves.
summary.zh-TW: 紀錄現在支援純網路商店，訪客也可以調整介面偏好並了解 ShopAlert 的更新歷程。

en-US: Added editable display filenames for newly selected and existing evidence media while retaining randomized server storage names.
Added a live current/total media index to report evidence galleries.
Localized Google Place Autocomplete and stored both English and Traditional Chinese formatted addresses so existing report views switch with the interface language.
Added up to 10 validated controversy/source URLs with Cloudflare URL Scanner checks, fail-closed malicious-link blocking, a cached server-generated screenshot, and confirmation on detail pages.
Added persistent failed-login limits with configurable retry windows, timed lockouts, and Retry-After responses.
Added optional Cloudflare Turnstile verification to login and sign-up, including server-side action and hostname checks.
Added a report-specific administrator contact window and a protected inbox for reviewing and resolving submitted concerns.
Changed evidence images to open in an accessible in-page preview instead of a new browser tab.
Added persistent last-updated timestamps to report details and redesigned date placement on desktop management cards.
Added a private My reports page and owner-only editing for report details, social links, and supporting evidence.
Reworked report evidence into a contained stage with image and video thumbnails that remains usable on narrow screens.
Assigned every report a stable GUID for public URLs while preserving redirects from legacy numeric links.
Added an online-shop option that removes the physical-address requirement and excludes the report from nearby searches.
Added complete English and Traditional Chinese interfaces with a persistent language selector.
Added light and dark themes plus a system mode that follows operating-system appearance changes.
Published a bilingual update timeline and a dedicated license and attribution page.
Kept preference controls accessible and responsive across desktop and mobile navigation.
zh-TW: 新增重新命名新選取及既有證據媒體顯示檔名的功能，伺服器端仍保留隨機儲存名稱。
紀錄證據相簿新增目前項目／總數的即時媒體索引。
Google 地點自動完成現在會同時儲存英文與繁體中文格式化地址，既有紀錄畫面會隨介面語言切換地址。
紀錄建立與編輯現在支援最多 10 個經驗證的爭議／來源網址，並加入 Cloudflare URL Scanner 檢查、惡意連結 Fail Closed 阻擋、伺服器快取截圖及詳細頁確認選項。
新增持久保存的登入失敗限制，可設定重試計算期間與定時鎖定，並提供 Retry-After 回應。
登入與註冊新增選用的 Cloudflare Turnstile 驗證，包含伺服器端 action 與主機名稱檢查。
新增針對個別紀錄聯絡管理員的視窗，以及可審查並處理提交疑慮的受保護收件匣。
將證據圖片改為在頁面內的無障礙預覽視窗開啟，不再另開瀏覽器分頁。
在紀錄詳細頁新增持續保存的最後更新時間，並重新設計桌面版管理卡片的日期位置。
新增私人的「我的紀錄」頁面，以及僅限擁有者編輯紀錄內容、社群連結與支持證據的功能。
將紀錄證據更新為包含圖片與影片縮圖的固定展示區，在窄螢幕上也能順暢使用。
為每筆紀錄配置穩定的 GUID 公開網址，同時保留舊有數字連結的重新導向。
新增網路商店選項，不需要實體地址，且該紀錄不會出現在附近搜尋結果中。
新增完整的英文與繁體中文介面，並提供可持續使用的語言選擇器。
新增淺色、深色及跟隨作業系統外觀變化的系統模式。
發布雙語更新時間軸，以及獨立的授權與來源標示頁面。
偏好設定控制項在桌面與行動版導覽中皆支援無障礙與響應式操作。

title.zh-TW: 以證據為基礎的店家紀錄

summary.en-US: ShopAlert launched with the core tools needed to document and discover community concerns about shops.
summary.zh-TW: ShopAlert 推出記錄與探索店家社群疑慮所需的核心工具。

en-US: Added secure account registration, sign-in, remembered sessions, and sign-out.
Required at least one supporting image or video for every published shop report.
Added shop details, controversy descriptions, official social links, and optional Google Place Autocomplete.
Added keyword search and nearby filtering using browser geolocation and selectable distance ranges.
Added responsive report cards, evidence galleries, allegation notices, and responsible-reporting guidance.
zh-TW: 新增安全的帳號註冊、登入、記住登入狀態及登出功能。
每筆發布的店家紀錄都必須包含至少一張支持圖片或一部影片。
新增店家資訊、爭議說明、官方社群連結，以及選用的 Google 地點自動完成。
新增關鍵字搜尋，以及使用瀏覽器定位與可選距離範圍的附近篩選。
新增響應式紀錄卡片、證據相簿、指控提醒及負責任分享指引。

summary.en-US: The first release established a small, maintainable application that runs locally with SQLite by default.
summary.zh-TW: 首個版本建立了精簡且易於維護的應用程式，預設可直接使用本機 SQLite 執行。

en-US: Built the application with Flask, SQLAlchemy, server-rendered Jinja templates, and vanilla JavaScript.
Added password hashing, CSRF protection, safe redirects, randomized upload names, and upload validation.
Made SQLite the zero-configuration default while retaining support for another SQLAlchemy database URL.
Added automated coverage for authentication, access control, reporting, media delivery, and search.
zh-TW: 使用 Flask、SQLAlchemy、伺服器端 Jinja 樣板及原生 JavaScript 建立應用程式。
新增密碼雜湊、CSRF 防護、安全轉址、隨機上傳檔名及上傳驗證。
將 SQLite 設為免設定的預設資料庫，同時保留其他 SQLAlchemy 資料庫網址的支援。
新增帳號驗證、權限控管、紀錄建立、媒體傳送及搜尋的自動化測試。
